简介: Donovan stars in Theater Camp (Sundance '23 Special Jury Award: Ensemble), and recently wrapped leads in "Spirit Halloween," and "The Dogs." He debuted in "Zoe" as the son of Ewan McGregor and Rashida Jones (Tribeca Centerpiece '18) and went on to appear in several TV series. On the stage, he was lead in the first reading for the new Stephen Daldry/Sonia Friedman stage project. He's an avid musician, singer and composer.
